## Checklist

- [ ] One skill per PR.
- [ ] Added `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with `---` frontmatter (`name`, `description`) + instructions.
- [ ] Added a matching entry to `skills.json` (`name`, `description`, `path`).
- [ ] `name` is lowercase/hyphenated and matches the folder.
- [ ] Instruction-only — no scripts, no network calls.
- [ ] No prompt-injection (doesn't override the user or safety).
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py` locally and it passed.
